_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: YES BANK POP-CLUB RuPay Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: No YES BANK page or document states the rupee value of a POPcoin. The partner (POPtech) home page says "1 POPcoin = ₹1" but its Terms (mypop.in/tnc) say coins are redeemed as a discount up to a maximum per purchase set by the company, or converted to cashback "at a rate the Company sets". The earlier partner-app read (₹0.10 per coin on cash conversion) conflicts. Left null.

eligibility_engine.notes: Apply through the partner (Pop Club) website or app; the partner may charge a platform fee. Page: age 21 to 60, salaried or self-employed, minimum net salary ₹25,000 a month or ITR of ₹7.5 lakh; existing YES BANK credit cardholders are not eligible.

dynamic_currency_conversion_dcc.trigger_condition: 1% + GST when a transaction is billed in INR at an international location or at an overseas-registered merchant in India (MITC 3(q), KFS)

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: 1% + GST when one fuel transaction exceeds ₹10,000 or the calendar-month fuel spend exceeds ₹25,000; fee capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(i))
1% + GST on utility and service transactions when the previous calendar month's utility spend exceeded ₹25,000; fee capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(h))
1% of the transaction (minimum ₹1 up to ₹1,000; minimum ₹199 above ₹1,000) + GST; at most 5 rental transactions in 30 days (MITC 3(e))
No fee on third-party wallet loads up to ₹2,000; 1% + GST above ₹2,000, at most ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(f))

1% + GST on education paid through third-party sites and apps (CRED, PhonePe, Housing.com, NoBroker, CheQ etc.), capped at ₹5,000 per calendar month; direct school/college site, POS and international education payments are not charged (MITC 3(g))
1% + GST when one toll/transport transaction exceeds ₹10,000 or the calendar-month spend exceeds ₹50,000; capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(j))
1% + GST when one transaction exceeds ₹30,000 or the calendar-month spend exceeds ₹80,000; capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(k))

reward_redemption_fee.notes: The ₹100 + GST redemption fee in the YES MITC is for YES Rewardz points. POPcoins are the partner currency redeemed on the partner platform; no redemption fee is stated for them.

components: 100% of GST + EMI amount + membership/rental/wallet fees + any amount over the credit limit
plus the higher of (finance charges + other fees + 2% of retail/cash outstanding) or ₹200 (MITC 6, KFS)

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Zero joining fee. Annual membership fee ₹399 + taxes is charged if the spend condition is not met; spending ₹1.5 lakh in the card anniversary year waives it (page T&C 2, MITC fee table, KFS). Cards issued under the "Lifetime Free" offer are exempt from the annual fee (page); the page calls lifetime free a limited-time offer and the cohort for a new applicant is not stated.

welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: On payment of the ₹399 annual fee, 400 POPcoins are credited (page T&C 2). Rupee value of a POPcoin is not stated by YES BANK.

spend_milestones.label: 1,500 extra POPcoins on crossing ₹1.5 lakh spend in the card anniversary year (also waives the annual fee; lifetime-free cards get the POPcoins too)

Partner app listing describes partial cashback conversion at 10 POPcoins per INR 1; shop discounts have separate restrictions.

open_questions: POPcoin rupee value: still not stated in any YES BANK page or document. The partner home page says 1 POPcoin = ₹1 but the partner Terms say coins redeem as a discount up to a per-purchase maximum or convert to cashback at a rate the company sets, and an earlier partner-app read gave 10 coins per ₹1 for cash conversion. point_value_inr_baseline stays null until a person decides which, if any, to rely on.

Fee cohort: the page calls "Lifetime Free" a limited-time offer. A new applicant may get a lifetime-free card (no renewal fee) or the ₹399 card; the page does not say which cohort is open. annual_fee_inr 399 is the standard fee (page, MITC, KFS).

Fuel surcharge waiver cap: the page footnote and the MITC/KFS bullet say ₹100 per statement cycle on ₹1,000 to ₹3,500 from 1 Jun 2026, but the MITC and KFS cap tables still list "POP-CLUB INR 300" (the pre-1-Jun figure). ₹100 is stored.
Whether the card is physical or virtual is not stated; the cash-advance fee (2.5% or ₹650, MITC) is written for a physical card.

The 1,500-POPcoin milestone is described per "anniversary year"; the page does not say whether it repeats each year, so is_repeatable is null. Whether the 400 POPcoins on paying the annual fee repeats on every renewal is also not stated.
POPcoin exclusions on the page are listed by MCC and are "not exhaustive and only indicative"; the education exclusion starts 1 Jun 2026.

value.rule: 10% of the statement balance or ₹1,350, whichever is lower, per statement; nothing if the current outstanding (statement balance + unbilled) is ₹500 or less
value.note: A percentage fee cannot be written as fixed slabs, so late_payment_slabs is empty.

rules: Late payment charge: no charge if the current outstanding (statement balance + unbilled) is up to ₹500; above ₹500, 10% of the statement balance or ₹1,350, whichever is lower, per statement (MITC 3(b), KFS).

Auto-debit / payment return failure: from 15 Jun 2026, 2.5% or ₹500 whichever is higher on the net payable amount, capped at ₹5,000 per customer per statement (before that 2% or ₹450, cap ₹1,500); cheque return ₹450 (MITC 3(d)).
Overlimit: ₹550 + GST per transaction that exceeds the limit (facility reintroduced 1 Jun 2026) (MITC 3(c)).

Cash advance: from 15 Jun 2026, 2.5% or ₹650 whichever is higher; before that 2.5% or ₹500; not applicable to virtual cards; cash withdrawal suspended for the first 6 months after onboarding; limit up to 30% of the credit limit (MITC 3(a), 5).
